hardwareHubs.note: Montana State University hosts the Bill Wurst Makerspace and the state MEP center.

makerspaces.name: Bill Wurst Makerspace
makerspaces.note: Lists 3D printers, CNC machines, a laser cutter, an electronics station and a textiles area, open to MSU students, faculty and staff.

specialties.name: Optics and photonics
specialties.note: A state economic development report says the optics and photonics cluster includes over 40 companies.

specialties.name: Outdoor gear and recreation products
specialties.note: An industry article says hundreds of companies design and manufacture outdoor gear in the state.

specialties.name: Wood products
specialties.note: A University of Montana research report lists wood, paper and furniture manufacturing among the state's manufacturing sectors.

support.name: Montana Manufacturing Extension Center (MMEC)
support.note: NIST MEP center at Montana State University offering lean, quality, supply chain and workforce help to manufacturers.
